Decent. But not nearly as strong as Charlotte.

Decent. But not as strong as Charlotte.

Second, he doesn't move because his passive lock him in place and prevent his SP gen. And his range is extremely bad.

Decent. But not nearly as strong as Charlotte.

The Auto win Button Against Total War Hard, and will be very useful in Ordeal as well.
In short, Briseis trivializes Total War Hard (not Nightmare and Inferno tho), being able to beat it with Yeow and Drake.
While that does take some block gen and SP gen on your accessory, she doesn't need any champion bonus at all.
Also, due to bug, her debuff is treated as buff and thus can be dispelled/buff blocked by your own hero. Watch out for that.
She is for Hard/Nightmare only. Do not use her in Inferno. She is only meant for new player to beat Total War.

Thalia, the "yet another newly added hero who power crept previous hero just a little bit".
Thalia's entire passive needs you to use her block, meaning her SM cannot trigger any of her passive.
So she's basically locked to MR. Other than that, Thalia doesn't offer much outside of damage.
Has range issue too. So, Despite her damage, don't fall for it.

Sure, just removed her gimmick for the sake of ease of play. Definitely a good way to introduce character variety.
That being said, the buff was not bad. The change can make her much easier to use at the cost of her character.
The increase in damage is nice, but not enough to make her catch up to the power crept to hell meta hero.

More offensive power is nice. But maybe could have used a little more.
All she got was an increase in her damage output, which is welcoming, but, like Miel, doesn't do that much.
Since the recent new heroes are.... all WAY out of her league by now.

Currently, Aramis has the HIGHEST BURST in the entire game, along with extreme consistency.
Aramis got probably the one and only relevant buff, making her DPS now on the top of the list.
That being said, her DPS still drops by 40% if she is fighting one on one. So do still keep that in mind.

Sure, just removed her gimmick for the sake of damage. Definitely a good way to introduce character variety.
All she got was an increase in her damage output, which is welcoming, but, like Miel, doesn't do that much.
Since the recent new heroes are.... all WAY out of her league by now. RIP stun lock.

Ok nevermind, her CD buff is multiplicative. OF COURSE IT IS. She is just Nebula. Full Neutral. With lower hit count.
First, she can't move. Maximizing DPS requires you to spam, meaning she is stuck in place unless you have Zahard. Bad for PvE.
Second, she needs time to transform to start dealing meaningful damage, time which you don't have for PvP and don't want for PvC.
She is still usable for raid, though no kaede because her clone can't transform, and her hit count while decent, can use a bit more.
As for Total War, she is an really capable DPS, you are still locked to the same few heroes to clear tho.
Still, it's another very consistent Damage Taken Increase hero.

You'd think a hero with reflect mechanic, tanking and Pen debuff would be good, HOWEVER.
Skadi's kit is incomplete for PvP. Her Pen debuff often activates after enemy DPS has already died, aka when it no longer matters.
Her reflect is good, but the 1 second delay on reflect is a bit slow. And given the current PvP one-shot meta her tankiness is lackluster.
As for PvC, why would you bring a slow start hero for PvC? For PvE, the buff she offer is rather lack luster by current standards.
Raid... Sera is Debuff Immune. But she is at least a fun DPS to tr... OH. She ignore debuff immune. OF COURSE SHE DOES.
For Total War, she is good. Note that YE reviving doesn't trigger her passive. Plus, she is locked to SP accessories due to the SP drain.

Literal trash.
Perhaps due to a coding error. Everything in her kit sounds nice. Until you realize her cooldown is 11s not 6s.
Her eva ignore isn't even real ignore eva. It's more akin to "treating enemy eva as 0 during calculation". So no Morgan synergy.
Shield? Block Gen? Magical damage immunity? You realize those are on a 11s cooldown right?

Very Broken
Extremely stupidly broken. Ranee has the strongest block gen in the game.
On top of that, she also has one of the strongest buff in the game.
76% Damage Buff, 75% CC, 40% Acc, and at least 250% more block? If this is not broken, what is?

Nico is a buffer. Nico is a buffer. Nico is a buffer. Keep that in mind when building and using her.
Nico boast a terrifying 8000% Atk based shield gen every 2s, 50% DR, 100% Atk and CD buff, and 20% DT.
These effectively makes her Woompa on steroids. The shield does get weaker with time tho, and she takes a while to start up her buff.
Because of the insane shield she has, she even serve as a very powerful pvp hero, if your opponent don't know what they are doing.

Affogato is the newest set up hero that has insane damage and block gen support. And nothing else.
Affogato can refund 4 blocks if he uses MR. However, because clones can't use SP, his clone can't stack SP, aka can't use SM.
That being said, even without SM, his DPS post set up is insane. Well, aLmoST aS HiGH aS ChArLoTte.
Setting up does still take a while, and apart from damage and block gen, unfortunately, Affogato doesn't offer much.

The new hero pass hero. Hey, at least she's free, you just need to be her dog for a month.
So, Charlotte really likes to 3 chain. And, assuming her passive we see in letter is correct, her DPS is ridiculously high.
That being said, she is also extremely block hungry even tho she has self block gen. Note she has no innate Pen buff as well.
All in all, she is a very strong DPS. But here is the thing, power creep has already started, why get this one when you can get a better one?

The new trade hero. Don't go for her. Hero trade is a scam.
The embodiment of scam herself. And, news just in. CQ deliberately nerfed her to make her a trash post release.
So, not only does she not work with shadow mage, they reduced her 3500% from 22 hits to 4 hits. Aka 77000% => 14000%.
You can see how that can make her useless. That being said, LS will turn her suicide into a full heal. So the LS bug is back.

Here is what we know so far:
1. You pick 12 heroes / 4 teams to go into battle (no goddess, no champion)
2. You can add 16 heroes as support to further increase your hero's performance (seems to be based on support hero's HP)
3. There are levels of AoW, like Ordeal
4. There's a practice button just like Ordeal.
5. There seems to be another buff based on the bond level of your hero. How this is calculated is still mystery.
6. Drops the new accessory: Earring
TLDR: This is the new ordeal.

Here is what we know so far:
1. Seems to be a rogue like? experience where you use a team to advance through a multiple of floors.
2. There are passives you can pick up along the way to further buff your character's strength.
3. There seem to be a system where you can permanently upgrade your hero performance within Pantheon of madness

She is Nyorori. She is just Nyorori. She is just a Nyorori clone, with a harder to trigger condition.
The free hero this time is incredibly busted, since she buffs with her buffed attack/arm/res. 
But because she needs to take a crit for it, it is not nearly as easy to control as you'd think.
For example, in a 3 hero team, the best you can pair her with would be Woompa, where she will buff atk by 16,000. 30,000 with BD.
For a raid team however, she can give an attack buff that goes into the 100,000. That is, if you can buff her before she buff you.

Buff is alright, but definitely can be better. All she has is still just damage, and lack of block gen means she's not beginner friendly.
With decent to strong support, she can perform decently well as a challenge farmer due to her increased range and damage.
But that's about all she has to offer. She has no utility whatsoever and she is too block hungry for her own good.
And she is not gonna get better for a long, long, long, long, long time because of how license work in gatcha game.

Nerfed to the ground.
With 0.16 Attack speed, you probably should build AS/AS on her. The DR buff only present when you upgrade, for only roughly 1s too.
Has insane Atk buff, ignores Eva and Tank. Sadly, 3 chain has been nerfed to the ground (15000% => 2500%), so just rely on auto attack.
In sum, even with top tier support still not that fast in challenge. But pretty good arena hero, if you like arena.

Uzume has 50% DT, 35% Res shred and pulling as a support; and extremely high offensive buff if she solos.
Because of arena's Res buff, Uzume's burst is even further increased, that and her shield and heal makes her solo actually viable.

A pretty fun hero to use, but do keep in mind: She is an all or nothing hero if you solo. And her block skill locks herself in place.

For some reason, CQ decided to give her a downside. If you run out of block she loses 50% of her HP and lose 50% CR.
Having downside is a welcoming change, but Tang doesn't justify such a downside, given her low DPS.
Also, note that she is Insanely Block Hungry, and her range is only subpar.

This guy is Not A Nyorori Clone. So he's not that broken in Sera raid, BUT 250% base Arm/Res buff is pretty good.
His Arm/Res buff is based on his base Arm/Res, while Nyo uses buffed arm/res. So the Nyo's buff is about 9 times stronger.
But, the 500% HP based neutral damage does hit pretty hard, so hopefully he is usable in arena.

Catch is, she has no range and she doesn't move. Oh no, anyway. We have Dara Lion Zahard to pull her.

Got an immunity against dispel, so Abel should be pretty good now.

The increase in damage and the guarantee crit removed Isis' previous issue, namely low DPS and low CC.
CD/CD is now recommended. Isis is now pretty dangerous in arena, feel free to try her out.

The buff is nice, but Nefer is still a lot weaker than most of the cast. Her speed is simply too slow.
Need another buff.

Gwen post buff, while is more useful than before, is still a toy hero. She is way too block hungry.

Buff is nice, and Athena now hits a lot lot harder. But that's pretty much it. 
She is not THAT much stronger than before and her weakness are all still there.

Now triggers from 2 block from ally instead of taking damage twice.

Jet now deletes tank like nobody's business. 50% DT is also pretty useful in some situation.

Buffs his attack with 150% of his AS. Albeit despite that, due to his low base 50% AS, CD/CD is better, but only slightly, than AS/AS.

Rochefort should be a good Eva hero now, except, he now has Eva ignore, so he counters eva. Still need his APen tho.

Enjoy the complete damage immunity against pretty much everything in the game, with the now 1000% Armor based damage reduction.
She will nullify pratically any non-critical damage and Bella damage. They also changed her damage type to neutral.

Strong heal, SP gen, Tank ignore Stun, tanking, and strong eva debuff. Roland is pretty good now.
Roland always had insanely high Res and Arm, so now he functions similar to Victoria, albeit not as well, but at least have access to good SP.
However, he is still very weak to dispel. Currently bugged and can apply his non-SBW passive for allies as well. It also forces them to do animation.

Stanya now has good block gen and her animation speed increase helped a lot in that case. Damage increase is ok too.
But still, her poor bulk makes her unreliable, and the tanking is usually more harmful than useful. 
In some scenario, she can almost serve as a Sworden counter, but don't expect too much out of her.

First, the in game description is a lie. She doesn't have 50% Damage boost, and she doesn't ignore tank or eva.

Did I mention those things are immuned to cleanse? Even aubrey cleanse, which meanse no debuff immunity? Truly, a joke no more.

The hero that unlocks your ticket to quickly beat up Sera with magical damage dealer.
Given most bosses are immune to stun anyway, she's good for challenge too, just note that she only buff a single hero, so no SM.
Note that most healer would have higher Atk than your DPS if you go full Atk (assuming they don't buff themself), so keep that in mind.

Average, at least she has all the mechanics needed to combat her own raid, but there are still better options.
Her DPS is mediocre, but she comes with her own SP. 
However, that is pretty much a downside at this point, since anyone who has her probably already have shadow mage.

Very good and is worth grinding for. But, note that she is NOT an Alfyn Clone.

However, she relies on putting a debuff on herself to do it, so you can't use Aubrey with her.

Yes, this is Eva Shuwen, enjoy fighting this guy. Best suit up with Eva Ignore. Btw, the passive is a lie. He punches for 1000%.

More damage, yay.

But, still doesn't have any pen buff nor any block gen.

More damage, and nolonger suffer from chasing 3 chain too much. Still need SP and Pen tho.

However, outside from needing SP and Pen, Meleager's splash damage is now extremely terrifying.

More damage, yay.

More damage, yay.

Has one of the more impressive lower investment clear times in challenge.

The general theme of this challenge is position check. There are several bosses in this challenge that has a position check mechanic, where your damage will be reduced by 95% if you are outside of the boss' barrier.

This challenge episode heavily favors melee heroes, especially melee heroes that are capable of dashing. Do not expect ranged heroes without sufficient burst to be rated highly here, as it is hard for you to stay reliably within the boss' barrier as to be able to deal any damage. Not only that, all of the bosses in EP4 challenge hits extremely hard, especially the hidden bosses; choose your options wisely, or you'll die.

If you are using a ranged team, it is suggested to run WoG on one your priests, or at least some form of dispel, as the position check mechanics are dispellable buffs that are reapplied at certain intervals. With dispel, the barrier mechanic can be partially bypassed, allowing consistent damage type ranged DPSes to kill these bosses. We are also clasifying the new challenge stages as endgame+ since you need to have high investments in terms of raw stats to even survive the stages and the fact that there isnt a team that clears 100% of the time that has decent times.

Archetype is split into 3 primary classifications, DPS, Tank, and Healer. 
What this refers to should be obvious enough.
A hero can receive multiple of these classifications.
With 4 sub-classifications, Buffer, Debuffer, Counter, and Utility.

Buffer - increase ally stats.
Debuffer - decrease enemy stats.
Counter - requires either getting hit or taking damage to activate their own passive.
Utility - fits into both the Buffer and Debuffer category. 
Utility may also refer to heroes that helps the team via methods other than stat buffs and stat debuffs, such as block generation.

⚔, indicating Offensive, assists the team's damage output.
⛨, indicating Defensive, assists the team's survivability.

You can select up to 16 hero from the 3 listed factions as support. 
The total max HP of the heroes determines the support effectiveness.
Factionless hero, namely collab hero, can also be selected. However, their total HP will be cut in half.

The support gauge is charged by dealing damage to the boss. The amount of dealt damage required to fully charge the gauge depends on the selected difficulty.
The requirement is: 200,000,000 [Hard] / 400,000,000 [Nightmare] / 600,000,000 [Inferno].

The formula for support damage is given as:
Damage = Sum of Support HP * Champion Count * (0.75 + 0.25 * Number of Unlocked Bond Skills + 0.05 * Total Bond Levels) + 1,000,000. 
This damage will always deal a fixed amount, ignoring enemy DR or Damage Taken increase debuff.

Her main utility is to provide frequent knockback, dispel, debuff immunity, and a ton of 3 chains while also murdering high Armor enemies. Tanking can often be considered a downside, however.
"Athena will be very strong" Well, she has self accuracy buff and incredible damage, but requires a lot of block gen. Shield also makes her relatively tanky.
Super Mecha Robot has undispellable tanking which can be neat, however he can't use Spirit of Protection and lacks defensive buffs aside from immunity.
The most useless hero in existence finally got buffed, and they way over did it. Well, she still have to pick between Pen and Res.

Nebula-tier base damage on top of being a res scaling DPS, meaning he gets access to some very broken buffers. Incredibly broken in non-moving scenarios, although dispel can be problematic for his damage potential.
Good damage against debuffed enemies, along with stuns and guaranteed 3-chains. Dies to debuff immune, so he's already dead.
He's an alright tank, undispellable since he can't be knocked out of his stance. Just not nearly tanky enough to deal with the current meta. 3-chains can be useful however.
Post buff V now has decent damage and interesting niche in 3 chain generation, however, her own damage is still not very high due to the lack of an offensive Paladin Soul skill.
Self Resis and CD buff along with SoP allows him to deal incredibly high damage with the right buffers. Self Apen buff also helps with his penetration requirements in challenge.
Decent eva counter, strong against large size enemy. Dragon killer finally getting that title back.
High base damage, head dropping is still a downside. But now his damage is very good now.
Good offensive buffer for wizards and hunters and can tank effectively with Spirit of Protection.
A lot of utility and a decent tank. Buff prevention and armor/resistance buffs can be useful.
Debuff is interesting but often not useful. Tank leaks quite a bit, but provides decent HA buffs.
No cooldown on reflect, which also happens to be direct damage (eva/tank ignore) makes him a menace when it comes to dealing with opponents with ridiculous hit count. Notably Umrat.
Usable for HA buffing. Also has a bit of defense when using with Spirit of Protection.
Excellent tank in PVC, ally block-based tanking and shield removal with a lot of defense buff really seals the deal for him.
Ok block generation. He almost gives you a maxed champion effect in Colosseum. Died after they nerfed him.
Good for activating ally 3-chains, tanking leaks qiuite a bit. DR buffs are god though. Very useful auto tool
Very good burst damage once in Rage mode, built in block generation and natural tankiness makes him very flexible. Biggest weakness is the initial start up time to enter Rage Mode.
Excellent PvC physical tank with insane self Armor buffs, a lot of utilities, and even more stuns. Weak to magical damage, however.
A paladin that specialized in hitting hard despite not hitting very hard. The downside can be mitigated by DR, so LoG actually almost save you from dying to it.
A physical tank with an unusual kit, being able to assist magical damage output. As a trade off, she isn't as tanky as other meta tanks. Overall, niche, but irreplacable when needed.
Unique kit with good damage, dispel, and assists the damage output of frontline heroes. Extremely prone to get stuck behind during block skill animation though.
Let him revive 3 times and he will murder everything in his path. Also has invincibility + tanking combo.
Possesses a nice variety of buffs and debuffs for magic DPSes, especially AS based ones, while also having tanking capability. Although, her tanking being dispellable is quite a shame.
A literal wall, personified. Healing based damage can also produce some interesting results for Ibelin abuse when paired with Bari + Sanctuary.
Cute eldritch abomination that has a pretty wide range of utility, but only works on bosses. May be a solid choice in events as her utility is similar to that of Shub's.
Kit is a little questionable, but mark damage is alright with flat penetration buffs.
Surprisingly high burst damage for a paladin. Pretty ok for Colosseum purposes.
Extremely good buffer that offer a multitude of buffs, being top tier even when not paired with physical DPSes. Do note that he doesn't work as well with ranged DPSes.
A tanky DPS that is pretty much designed to counter the current arena meta. Tank ignore neutral damage with enemy armor scaling plus eva ignore is plenty balanced.
Used to be a DPS, but her damage isn't really on-par anymore. Better now just to user her as an ally 3-chain activator.
Why is there an empty row here?
Insane damage output and has potential to use tank ignore, where the RNG nature is the only reason he didn't receive OP in arena. What the fuck HG was thinking when designing this monstrosity.
Lack of Apen really pushes his burst damage down. Still decent damage but takes too long to activate with little return.
Technically can be an eva tank.
Armor/resistance shred is the only thing he's useful for at this point.
Imagine if she buffed 500% HA rather than 500 HA.
Technically can be an eva tank.
Not a bad support. 50% damage increase as well as SP generation and DR to support SoP is good. A bit clunky nontheless.
371% Apen HA Armor Resistance undispellable buff is plenty balanced.
RIP her infamous buff stacking ability. That said, she is still viable in all circumstances with her above-average defense and HA buffs, just not as broken as before.
Nice tank, ally-block-based tanking. Prioritize his 1-chains. Nice damage with Bella as well.
Her passive is mistranslated, leader needs to TAKE 25 hits, not DEAL 25 hits. Why.
Fast burst and high DPS, neutral bleed allows him to become viable against all opponents in colo. Does have range issues, and over reliance on ally 3 chains hinders his damage consistency.
Decently tanky in colo along with nice Armor shred. Problem with him is that, he is simply... outclassed by existing options, namely Caen in PvC and Fenrir in PvE.
Insanely fast 3 chain activation turns many 3 chain chasers into instant nukes. Do note that, due to animation lag, his Evasion debuff will be delayed severely.
A standard DPS paladin with extremely quick burst and high base damage. She is comparably block hungry, but is a versatile choice overall.
Good tank that comes with HA debuff, stun and knockback. His tanking is also undispellable. However, before SoP, he is rather frail and his debuff can easily be tanked.
Decent burst damage. Enemies pretty much always have buffs, which triggers her passive. For whatever reason, buffs and debuffs on Sigruna are accelerated.
Post buff Demona has very good damage, unfortunately, she doesn't offer much besides that. One of the few archer that actually has a self atk buff, a strong one at that.
Good HP burst damage, also shreds armor and dispels. Can be deadly in PVC.
Good damage and consistent stuns with chase 3 and auto chase 3. The fact that his auto chase 3 doesn't have animation makes him fun to use when used abused correctly.
Being a chase 3, you pretty much have to use her with Yeowoodong.
Waveclear is good and has high Rpen, however his single target DPS is nonexistent. Can abuse good archer SP, well, specifically VoS. Extremely block hungry tho.
Decent damage, but doesn't offer anything special.
Good burst damage and effectively shuts down backline. High Rpen buff and a bit of AoE helps with certain story clears.
In search of his cannibalistic cure for his wife, he found the gate to hell, and traded everything to murder anything that flies, no matter the condition.
Not terrible, autochase gives armor shred, dispel, and a sizable amount of damage. But she has no damage, and her animation is snail.
She has very good damage now, along with extremely consistent damage. She is a force to be reckon with.
If only her damage requirement wasn't so awkward. Two ally consecutive 3-chains often limits the team possibilities.
Fast tank ignore activation and constant knockback makes her a monster in PvP. Less viable in PvC, but scary nonetheless. Works wonders in the right team.
Activates off enemy receiving buff or ally 3-chain. Without Caeneus, performance is quite poor.
Good damage with decent waveclear, shred is useful as well. Can either be used as chaser or as leader for 1-chain spam. Does have range issues.
Good damage and 3 chain engine. Somehow eagle makes for a good archery teacher.
Now she hits like a truck, and good auto potential. Apply poison build can still work tho. Very useful in Sera raid.
Tank ignore, free Apen, and fast activation gives him global perma stun capabilities. Totally balanced.
High damage, however is a little weaker if the enemy moves around frequently and avoids Tombstone radius. Apen issue as well.
Amazing single-target DPS. Also metric ton of utility, inculding defense shred, several debuffs, dispels, etc..  Can't wave clear tho.
Good single target DPS with impressive armor shred and tank ignore can be useful. Struggles againsts debuff immunity unfortunately.
Very good damage, but block RNG is strong with this one, also lacks Apen.
Very high single target frontline DPS with some wave clear splashed in. She does have some pen issues and isnt very user friendly when used as a solo DPS.
Good AoE damage with decent sustain damage plus dispel every few often. Range is an issue, and SP skill can be hard to get sometimes. Not bad at all however.
Good consistent burst DPS. Crit reliant can have inconsistencies but clone crits counting as well makes most CR sources negligible. Does have range issues.
Locked to Jeomyre because the latter can generate 3 chain every 0.5s, perfectly matching her passive. Strong for raid, but Jeomyre gets hard fucked by auto.
Good DPS that also offers splash damage. However, his Rpen is unreliable, chase 3 has priority over block skill, so it's best to use only 6 ally 3cs within the duration of his mark.
Excellent damage potential, but can be rather block hungry due to her fast animation. Completely crippled if she does not crit.
Very good consistent damage combined with good hit count. Perhaps designed as a sub DPS given her party wide CC buff.
Power Creep. Very high damage, and very useful for checking hero AS. But other than that, there isn't much to talk about.
Despite being told as "as strong as Lupeow" in Dev Stream, she's just another generic DPS. That said, her melee stance is quite unique for an archer... but why not just use a melee DPS?
Very good when paired with an ally/summon with extremely high HA. Currently completely broken wen paired with Kaede due to a "feature"
Very consistent damage and near instant auto chase makes he a good hero for AFK, but her damage overall is quite lacking.
Very consistent hero with good range and damage, and come with shred. Flying also make her a good pick against common meta hero like Ran and Bihwa. Panpan tho...
We live in a world where getting slapped by fish hurts more than bullet. More or less an archer Malsook.
Primrose clone, but physical damage. That's about it.
Surprisingly high damage. Rpen issue however, but the burst can be massive to frontline. Isn't a wizard.
Very block hungry and burst is inconsistent. Could have use in duture content with unique SP Skill Ability.
Backline snipe is pretty good with heavy AoE damage. Curve shot does only seek lowest HP enemy. Frontline and shields counter usually.
Possesses one of the most broken buffs in CQ - no, buff being self + leader is not much of a demerit - while possessing ridiculous burst DPS on top of it. Yeah, that sounds balanced, does it not?
Extremely block hungry and doesn't have the block gen for it. Gotta catch'em All, if only those beasts last longer than 5 uses.
Usually used as an AFK hero that has a decent amount of DPS, and used in a team of 3 D'arts.
Good burst, consistent, and doesn't need a lot of blocks. However, it's hard to make SP drain viable when opponents can one-shot you without SP. Just another generic DPS in the end.
She is a decent DPS that deal damage and can act fairly well as a 3 chain engine.
Promo buffer that relies on debuff to increase ally damage output. Combined with SP can also provide shred, and is decent for ibelin abuse.
Has decent DPS, but his chase 3 is difficult to use due to cooldown. Tank ignore is ok, but due to power creep, not nearly as useful.
DPS is alright, but lacks any distinguishing traits to be useful. Auto also hurts him due to his "short range".
Highest resistance shredder in the game, and works as a decent 3 chain engine.
Hits stupidly hard and also has a self dash, now pretty much a mini-Ran.
High damage, fast burst, heal prevention, and team wide knockback makes her one of the most threatening DPSes in both colo and arena.
All she has is damage, albeit a decent amount. And she doesn't work with Kaede, for whatever reason.
Bad and all he has is DT debuff.
He now hits decently hard with every block skill and offer extremely high SP gen for the leader. He does lose a lot of damage when enemy is far away tho.
Excellent single target DPS and eliminates backliners from existence. But she is weak against enemy CR.
Unfortunately, all she has is some shred and stun, and she has no damage at all.
Low damage and offers no niche whatsoever.
Extremely low damage and offers no niche whatsoever.
What does she do beside unlocking DS again?
Dogs summons are heavily RNG and not reliable for damage. Dox also can't activate his own marks. However mark activations via ally can hurt quite a bit.
Drill can be spammed easily and has built in high Apen, and her chase method isn't as easilly managed as you'd think.
Neo the Tormentor has decent damage, but unfortunately has no card effect that offers any form of niche.
Layla the Sky Dragon has decent damage, but just like Neo, offers no niche in anyway.
All Winged Dragon of Mel has is ranged AoE knockback, but her damage is extremely bad.
Raven's biggest upside is you get to use a character with a nuke. But her damage is only decent.
Buffs are strong, but is difficult to maintain after you have all 3 stacked on top of his head. Why do they have to stack themselves anyway.
Decent damage with block gen support, but has rather low range. Remember, don't dual wield Great Sword, or you will fat roll like this guy.
Zahard Express, teleporting all hero right to the enemy's face. While he offers a strong Eva buff, unfortunately he has no damage.
Slaughters tanks with a passion. 50% DT debuff is decent too.
A hunter that prefers melee so much more that she teleports in front of you to do it. And her damage is quite good too.
Consistent damage, incredibe self block gen, and Eva ignore. Though, imagine if she had some innate pen buffs. Would that not make for a solid DPS in ordeal?
Decent initial burst, fast 3c, and piercing tank ignore burst damage. Her damage isn't as impressive as before, however.
A solid DPS with the highest hit count within the hunter class and quite a bit of shred, but is extremely prone to cleanse. One of the best DPSes in Mecha Toto.
His entire kit revolves around his built-in skill which does decent consistent tank ignore damage, but is also extremely prone to dispels and stuns.

Her main niche lies in her ridiculous damage potential on top of no bullet travel time, which allows her to practically one shot most challenge bosses in a single activation. Her DPS does drop against singular enemy, but only slightly.
Ruby clone that actually works, but unfortunately doesn't work under auto challenge. What can you do when HG just hates you.
Joined after getting smashed in C11, Svenja has very high Apen due to her self buff and shred. She also works pretty well with SP spamming.
Has decent CR and Arm debuff, but otherwise he is only decent.
Good damage, good base stat, and good hit count. Also possesses high shred and constant dispel that also locks opponent buffs. Eggplant OP.
CAT GUN. Does have high damage and some small shreds. Not much utility else whatsoever, but doesn't have significant downsides either.
After a serie of power creep, Olga is no longer as crazy as she used to be, but she is still pretty strong. Someone wants to see the world burn.
Still suffers from her block skill missing most of the time, but her damage output, when she works, is still pretty decent.
Her damage is not bad, and the niche of uninteractable buff is interesting. Though, the need of 2 hard 3 chain heavily slows her down, and she can have issue fighting enemy with knockback.
A little startup time but once passive activates then this bear is on a roll.
Damage is on par with Bihwa but is full neutral, provides damage boosts on par with Primrose (bar the penetration), and with infinite range at that. This totally sounds balanced.
Elphelt came to hasla to find a husband, but all she found was that nobody liked her due to her low damage output.
Being able to deal damage based on enemy HP was a crazy feat, but damage cap had ruined Leona completely. Now she is only useful against a sandbag made of straw.
While she can generate 3 chain at a high rate and offer Apen buff, the buff doesn't last very long and it's difficult keep her airborne.
Passive jams her block generation queue more than anything, Heart Grenades doesn't deal enough damage to too small of an area.
Only thing he's useful for is a free 3-chain.
Did you know that it cost 120,000 gold to use her skill? It's a good thing it doesn't cost that much in CQ right?
High pen, high damage, tank ignore, dispel. All you will need for Arena packaged in a neat little Intercontinental ballistic missile. This is Dorothy, and she will murder everything in her way.
Deals more damage the more enemies there are, terrible damage in Challenge due to lack of enemies. More useful for HA buff.
Decent penetration buff, damage is good. However, needs a lot of HA buffs to scale effectively. Range also is an issue.
Currently the best promote neutral damage dealer. However, her performance is still lackstur. Also has a range issue and can cause her to lag behind the team if you spam blocks.
Pretty slow in outputting damage and lacks Rpen. Pretty block hungry too.
Good waveclear damage but activation requirement and lack of Rpen sets her back too much.
Excellent waveclearer that assists damage and survivability through a wide variety of potent debuffs.
Useless against debuff immunity and meh shred, but his consistent and decent-ish tank ignoring damage provides a niche for the new raid.
Excellent for dispel spam, but completely useless outside of that.
I've never seen a hero more incapable. But hey, he still has the highest base HA in the game, so that's that.
Waveclear is alright, Rpen is nonexistent, damage is mediocre.
Excellent for stalling backline snipers thanks to her self revive, along with 3 chain utility. However, her utility outside of this use is pretty much nonexistent.
The buff doubled her damage output, but she is still kind of bad. The Atk debuff also doesn't help her by a lot, and she is still very block hungry.
Excellent Resistance shredder and damage is decent. Unfortunately countered by debuff immunity.
Ghosts scale pretty well, but Rpen is an issue. The amount of HA they get from Necron's HP can be massive however.
"Demeter will be very strong" Says Dev. Well, she's decent and she does hit decently hard, but the nerf to her Rpen really hurts. Her hit count wasn't even buffed.
Guillotine damage is mediocre without much Rpen. Takes too long to reach there and sacrifices critical damage for more attack speed.
Damage is the very definition of insanity. She is, however, locked with Evasion buffers, namely Lia, for proper functioning.
Very good mage for waveclear, splash damage from bubbles scale with the number of enemies. Single target damage isn't great though.
Bunny's damage is insanely consistent and deals a lot of damage, however is fragile and very vulnerable to knockback.
Insane flat HA buffs makes her a S tier support for Almael and Delrien. For general use, precise block management is required for the buff to stay on the right hero.
Passive activation off ally chains offer him a lot of waveclear ability. Decent single target DPS too.
Single target damage is excellent and has massive burst potential, however runs into an Rpen issue.
Ice Pillars have no range and the Rpen buff really isn't enough. Damage is decent.
Very consistent burst provided there is a consistent priest on his team.
High consistent damage paired with numerous buffs, high Rpen, and tank ignore makes her an excellent DPS unit, especially for arena.
Burst damage is absolutely insane. Does have a Rpen issue.
A wizard that excels at disruption with a decent kill potential, but his overall damage isn't all that high.
Despite being forced to run MR, her damage still comes as servicable. Due to having a decent burst and a giant res shred, she is a very new player friendly wizard.
A wizard with shadow mage synergy but doesn't work with shadow mage. Otherwise has good burst and comes with shred. At least she's pretty F2P friendly, since MR is her optimal skill.
Strong neutral bursts that activate off debuffs, allowing him to counter Lion and Shub to a certain extent. Also comes with absolutely insane self SP generation.
Weird activation requirement, and only hits frontline. Damage isn't bad, but the aforementioned problems really limits her usage.
Widespread dispel with mediocre damage but... that's about it.
Impressive DPS, strong self buffs and debuffs, and not block hungry at all. Debuff based damage does mean she can't use SM, otherwise, her inability to hit air would be the only other detriment.
A new age of AS based DPS whereby his low base AS makes using his blocks a damage gain rather than a damage loss. Impressive clear times in challenge, but penetration is an issue.
Fake muscles, cool screen smashes, with a good part of his description completely wrong. Incredibly block hungry, but when satisfied can make for impressive clear times in challenge.
High consistent damage, dispels does counter her pretty hard though. Works well with Ibelin.
High consistent damage, Whirlwind provides good burst potential. Range issue is present and sometimes has a position-lock issue.
The definition of endgame toy; good at one thing and trash at the rest. Her damage being tied to the enemy being immobile for long periods of time limits her a lot.
Definitely not bad. Suffers from a lack of sufficient Apen/Rpen, but damage is pretty high. Skill is good enough to make up for missing Shadow Mage.
Decent damage output along with high innate Rpen. Her short range is definitely a problem though.
Good damage and comes with her own SP that is generally on par with SM, but is rather block hungry. Loses a lot of her damage if she is not leading, which does limit her flexibility.
A capable challenge DPS with one of the fastest projectile speeds in game, but his full potential is locked behind Francesca.
An ancient god whose damage output is quite mediocre, but is the bare minimum required to deal with her own raid as a capable DPS.

So. Her damage is the highest in the game, and by a gigantic margin. 
Her damage is so high that 11 of her will have more DPS than every other hero in the game, 300 of them, combined. 
Catch is, she has no range and she doesn't move. Oh no, anyway. We have Dara Lion Zahard to pull her.
Damage is too low and takes too long to reach the burst, though penetration is hardly an issue post-buff.
Takes way too many blocks to reach her explosion, which doesn't even deal that much damage. Though, the sheer number of fragile summons she can procure is rather useful for Hrolf.
Excellent waveclear ability and deals high consistent damage, but penetration is still an issue.
Magnolia damage is too delayed and damage isn't worth the block requirement. But she's cute, so that's all that matters... right?
Very consistent damage and clears waves effectively. Performance lowers against high HP bosses though.
High and consistent damage, takes some time to stack up and debuff immunity can prevent a lot of her passive.
Neutral damage requirement is too niche and removal of SP generation via blocks hurts.
Burst damage is good but cooldown is too long. Rpen can be an issue if initial burst doesn't kill.
Mediocre damage, and while very consistent, takes too long to utilize her kit.
Has some start up time, but neutral damage can become insane once stacked. Motion speed debuffs also buys her time.
His damage is fast. That being said, he doesn't have any damage as almost everything has more HP than him. 95% of the time he will be debuffing himself.
Damage is pretty good, and can stun without actually hitting the target, but all of these are locked behind evading 4 hits. Play around this limitation and she can be viable.
Buffs flat penetration, percentage armor and resistance. Good support for heroes who lack Rpen, especially in early and mid game. Chases are also true 3-chains.
A multitude of potent debuffs alongside heal prevention and decent damage, but is hard countered by debuff immunity.
SP generation can be useful in par with skills, but provides little utility aside from that. Hit immunity only goes on healed ally and can't be really controlled.
Consistent block engine with decent buffs, which provides her with amazing sustainability when it is needed. Does need some time to warm up, however.
High damage amplification and protection. Can be RNG but with the amount of time she heals, the RNG swings in a player's favor more often than not.
Buff totem stacks with SBW totem which can give him a massive boost in damage buff. 2-chain activating as 3-chains also allows chasers to chase quickly. Very verstaile.
Requiring allies to die in order to summon a clone makes him useless. Might as well as use Kaede. The 50% HA buff is useful at least.
Extremely powerful defensive buffer providing strong DPS against multi-hit heroes, while casting double buff for allies behind her. However, "Bug Fix", dispel, and neutral all pose danger to her kit.
Shield and buff are good. Moderately consistent shielding and some SP generation can help a lot in defense and offense in Story.
Style of buff prevention is very strange and doesn't really work most of the time.
Although not very useful in permanent contents, but for ordeal, disposable tanking is oddly effective when up against highly damaging enemies. Eva debuff on both sides is also quite nice.
Debuff range can be problematic. Needs to be in the enemy's face in order to debuff HA.
Overall good buffer, provides both defensive and offensive buffs.
Excellent HA debuffer, completely shuts down most PVE bosses with a massive debuff. Also spam activates 3-chains.
Insane SP generator, spits out special skills very often and provides some decent buffs.
Useful for activating 3-chains by allies, however lacks buffs aside from that.
Heavily based on stats but can buff a ton of attack power, armor, or resistance.
High HA buff, CC buff, and Accuracy buff. Buff doesn't last too long however.
Decent chain activator, however animation can be really long and lacks high buffs.
Buff would be good if his potions would land on the team. More often than not either Faust behind or just throws it on the ground somewhere in front of him.
Has a bit of everything that defensive and utility buffers can offer, but doesn't quite excel at any single role. Still a rather competent arena support nonetheless.
Block gen, accuarcy buff, heal block, and buff amplification makes her a viable choice in a variety of situations. Main utility is still block generation.
Allows allies to activate 3-chains very quickly and also provides some basic defense.
Consistent accuracy and penetration buff makes her a good support for all that lacks penetration in PvE.
Good 3-chain generator and also good for buffing critical chance and accuracy. Cooldown can be annoying.
Provides a massive damage boost through her strong CD and HA buffs, can sometimes outperform Woopa if you got the CC part covered. Lifesteal also assists the DPS's survivability. .
Excellent disruptor that does a bit of everything, dmg amplification, some tank ignore, root, undispellable dmg immunity, dispel, and good burst damage. Utility is irreplacable at times.
Very good defensive buffer, provides both DR, shield, and defense buffs. RIP to full up time debuff immunity and constant cleanse. Ferris clone.
Strong heals on top of good damage and buff prevention. Useful in a multitude of scenarios.
Excellent defensive priest against multihitting enemies due to her incredibly powerful reactive heals. DR buff and block generation also adds to the team's survivability.
Good offensive buffs with short duration, but it being sustained by ally 3 chain makes it consistent. His block generation helps significantly with maintaining burst.
A decently potent buffer that assists physical DPSes by offering things no one else offers consistently. Note that, she only buff ally with the highest base Acc, meaning she still works with Morgan.
Murders anything that heals, and single handedly changed the ban pick process in arena just by being a latent threat. Pretty much does nothing if opponent does not heal though.
Turns out healing enemy is a huge demerit, who could have guessed. Well, at least you have an option if you want to force Zeus, might not even be worth it though, sadly.

Priest Schild, but exchanges the damage for having priest skill set, SP drain, and ignoring debuff immunity. Considering there are only 3 CR shred + dmg amp heroes in game, her viability in Total War is only rivaled by Schild. Granted, you'd use them together, so there's not much to compare.
Cloning leader can be very very useful and makes her incredibly flexible.
Provive an undispellable knockback, knockup and debuff immunity buff. Great counter pick against disrupting or heavy debuff teams in Arena. Does have uptime issue but it shouldn't matter.
A DPS Priest built to counter Eva. However, when paired with Morgan where his negative Accu can proactively trigger Krampus, he can, and will, tear through everything.
Provides incredibly potent buffs that can be customized based on his builds. Due to this nature, having multiple copies of him can let you bring out his full potential.
Can be annoying to use without Fredrick. Does provide excellent shreds and damage amplify. Her dispel and neutral damage is especially scary in Arena.
Possessing strong offensive buffs, Chocolat is a capable buffer that practically everyone has access to... but if she is this good then why is she free? Answer: range issues. Fuck.
Best block gen generator in the game that also provides broken buffs for magical damage heroes. Also has super strong AFK potential as he chase after any form of leader ally attacks.
Mediocre damage and buff prevention is a bit slow. Heals a metric ton, though.
Range of explosion on ally revive is way too short to be effective. Block damage is much too low.
Decent buffs and debuffs, however is RNG with activations. Can be useful in specific situations.
Very good defensive buffer, provides both DR, shield, and defense buffs. RIP to full up time debuff immunity and constant cleanse. That one hero who killed off all the fun in CQ.
Lizard damage is excellent and provides a good amount of utility as well. Can be used as an effective DPS for burst damage.
Wall does not take into account ally stats after fix. Now summons a raw HP tank that offers limited defensive utility. RIP.
A stronger and more stable Orfeo. However, as her buff only affects the leader, it does limit her in team building.
The buffs are activated easily, but his tank trait disrupts his ability to utilize those kits. However, he can be a situational replacement for Aria.
Her wide variety of buffs can be utilized to assist damage output while ensuring the team's survivability. May be considered a Cronette upgrade.
Strong block gen capability and provides some decent buffs. But what makes her truly unique is her ability to cleanse unremovable debuffs, which leads to some interesting interactions.
Bad healer, bad tank, bad DPS. On top of that, all of her buffs can be dispelled.

22.t: Note for Mobile user
Challenge focused build. With hanee the difference between 1 as vs 2 as is 15 hits versus 17 hits before the buff ran out.
Trades some DR and CR for more Colosseum/Arena damage
Maximum survival, forsaking crit chance for survival while keeping high base damage
Eva: 110%. Albeit it is more RNG reliant, it does mitigate the effect of Bella.
Alternative build which minimizes damage loss through lack of penetration, and damage is supplemented by supports.
3 Chain starter for May/Fireaxe team.
Build to maximize damage output
A build for survivability. Eva should be better than DR in this case. Since with Eva/Eva, daughter can reach 100% base Eva, which is pretty good.
This build allows morgan to become a more flexible choice in arena.
Difference between CD CC and CD CD isn't very significant, so it's fine to use either. CD CC can be slightly better in colo, however.
